title: Lars Mittank: The Man Who Ran Into the Forest
description: In 2014, German tourist Lars Mittank disappeared near Varna Airport in Bulgaria. Security footage showed him running out of the airport and toward nearby wooded land. He has never been found.

scenes.narration: In July 2014, German tourist Lars Mittank was waiting at an airport in Bulgaria before his flight home.
